subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The documentary explored the historical and cultural significance of the ________ (antique) ruins in the region.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"antique"** means something that is old and often valuable because of its age. (प्राचीन)

 
 
• **Example: **She collects antique furniture from the 18th century.
 
 
 
• **"Ancient" **refers to something belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence. (प्राचीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The ancient pyramids of Egypt are a marvel of engineering.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'antique' **is **'ancient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Contemporary **(समकालीन): Belonging to the same period of time as something else.

 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys contemporary art.
 
 
 
• **Obsolete **(पुराना): No longer produced or used; out of date.
 
 
• **Example: **Typewriters have become obsolete in the digital age.
 
 
 
• **Modern** (आधुनिक): Relating to the present or recent times.
 
 
• **Example:** Modern technology has revolutionized the way we communicate.
 
 

4d:Tcc5,

The correct answer is: Option 2</b
